sentences.text: On the evidence provided, the cited UCB pre-payment restrictions expressly prohibit pre-payment charges for floating-rate loans in the stated cases, while “other” cases are left to the UCB’s approved policy.
The evidence also says the dual/special-rate rule depends on whether the loan is on floating rate at the time of pre-payment, which does not describe a fixed-rate term loan as stated in the question.
The bank’s own product note says a 2% foreclosure charge applies to non-individual corporate borrowers on a term loan.
I could not confirm whether the loan was sanctioned or renewed on or after 2026-01-01, so I could not fully test the timing condition in the UCB directions.

missing.searched: Searched the provided facts and rule findings for the loan sanction or renewal date needed to test the timing condition in the UCB pre-payment directions.
